title: If the law is spiritual for Paul, blessings are spiritual too
english: If the law is spiritual for Paul, then its blessings are spiritual as well—not only the fruits of the earth, but the victory of the soul.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is opening a new homily by arguing from Paul's authority that the law's blessings must be understood spiritually, not as earthly rewards.

title: Rain as teaching and the heart as soil
english: "If you will have walked in my precepts, I will give rains" (Leviticus 26:3-4). The rain is the rain of teaching. The earth of the heart sprouts.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is interpreting the Levitical blessings spiritually, applying the promise of rain to the soul's reception of doctrine.

title: Peace and the few who rout many
english: Peace on earth; five hundred will pursue. The peace of Christ; a few strong men the backs of enemies.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is expounding the blessings promised in Leviticus 26 to those who walk in God's precepts, interpreting them spiritually.

title: God's indwelling presence among the faithful
english: "I will walk among you, and I will be your God" (Leviticus 26:12). The indwelling of God. The temple of the Spirit.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is applying the blessings promised in Leviticus to the spiritual life of the believer, moving from peace and victory to the promise of God's abiding presence.

title: Merciful chastisement for disobedience
english: If you will not have heard, I will visit in a rod (Leviticus 26:14, 16). Merciful chastisement. Turn back.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is expounding the covenant blessings and curses of Leviticus 26, now turning to God's warning of punishment for those who do not hear.

title: Sevenfold Plagues and the Stiff Neck
english: I will add plagues sevenfold (Leviticus 26:18, 21). An increase of punishment toward conversion. Do not harden the neck (Leviticus 26:41).
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is continuing his homiletic paraphrase of the covenant curses in Leviticus 26, applying each threat as a merciful call to conversion.

title: Closing doxology and colophon
english: I will remember the covenant; I will not cast away to the end. Mercy remains. The Sixteen Homilies on Leviticus are completed. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is concluding the sixteenth homily on Leviticus with a final recollection of God's covenant mercy, followed by a scribal colophon and doxology.
